text.aria-label: Title text 'All 7 arms lower CRPS on day 1 and day 2, and G-lb, D, RR (recipe R), N-rule (post hoc), N-flag, real graph (post hoc), and N-gate, real graph (post hoc) raise it by days 8 to 10.'
text.tspan: All 7 arms lower CRPS on day 1 and day 2, and G-lb, D, RR (recipe R),
N-rule (post hoc), N-flag, real graph (post hoc), and N-gate, real
graph (post hoc) raise it by days 8 to 10.

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'CRPS of each arm minus CRPS of the stored normal-running forecast (S-NRA) on the same rows, event-free real rows, 14 Primaries pooled. The stage 2 arms are post hoc. Stage 1 scores origins from 2025-12 and stage 2 from 2026-01, so the two sets of rows differ and each arm is differenced against S-NRA on its own rows.'
text.tspan: CRPS of each arm minus CRPS of the stored normal-running forecast (S-NRA) on the same rows,
event-free real rows, 14 Primaries pooled. The stage 2 arms are post hoc. Stage 1 scores
origins from 2025-12 and stage 2 from 2026-01, so the two sets of rows differ and each arm is
differenced against S-NRA on its own rows.
